A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete ICE-Bench paper, including Appendices A-C. Extracted text and rendered pages match throughout, except for the first-page arXiv version/date notice.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluations of ten image-generation models across 31 tasks, with quantitative results in main Tables 2-5 and Appendix C, plus qualitative comparisons.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original model evaluations, numerical results, and qualitative comparisons in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: The benchmark construction pipeline and evaluation procedures, including VLLM-QA using Qwen2-VL-72B, are identical in Section 3 and Appendix B.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same 6,538 instances across 31 image-creation and editing tasks, with unchanged real and synthetic data coverage (Section 3; Appendix A).

E2.justification: The same ten evaluated models and their task-specific comparison memberships are retained in main Tables 2-5 and Appendix Tables 2-8.

E3.justification: Metrics, normalization, resizing to 1024-pixel height for MUSIQ, default model settings, and zero scores for unsupported tasks remain unchanged (Section 4; Appendix B).

E4.justification: The qualitative metric-effectiveness cases in Section 4.5, main Figure 5, and Appendix B are identical. No ablation, robustness test, or sensitivity analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Point-score reporting is unchanged. Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Main Tables 2-5, Appendix Tables 3-8, and the qualitative comparisons contain identical results. No numerical entries, rankings, trends, or reported findings change.

T1.justification: The mathematical metric definitions and normalization formulas in Appendix B, Equations (1)-(10), are identical. No assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about a unified benchmark with 31 tasks, six evaluation dimensions, 11 metrics, and hybrid data.

C2.justification: Section 5 retains the same interpretations concerning model generality, scaling and data quality, reference-consistency tradeoffs, and pixel-aligned training. No limitations or applicability qualifications change.

D1.justification: Software, A100 hardware, default hyperparameters, data schema, and metric implementation details remain identical. Code/data access statements and their links are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, the dataset comparison in Table 1, and all 60 references are unchanged, preserving the same positioning relative to prior benchmarks and generation methods.

P1.justification: Only the first-page arXiv notice changes from v1 dated 18 Mar 2025 to v2 dated 17 Aug 2025. Manuscript wording, authors, terminology, and section organization are identical.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, captions, and page layout are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. The version/date notice changes text without redesigning the presentation.

improvement.justification: v2 preserves the same scientific content, empirical evidence, explanations, and appendix material. The updated arXiv notice and PDF metadata do not materially affect the paper's rigor, clarity, or reproducibility.
